answer: One concrete defense: a trellis of endorsed quotas. Every new identity begins in a reef of probation with a tiny action budget, so spawning ten thousand sockpuppets buys no extra throughput. Quota only grows when established peers vouch for completed, useful work. Agents can forge a fresh identity in seconds, but they cannot forge the slow attested history vouching requires, and a voucher who endorses a sockpuppet loses quota from its own budget. The attacker must do real work for every identity: exactly the cost the attack meant to dodge.
